thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging — router tail latency spike detected (p99 > 2.5s) in us-west2 across streaming ingress. Auto-escalation to oncall.
Priya (oncall): I'm on it, pulling traces and topology. Any initial customer impact?
Lena (cs): A handful of paying customers reported streaming stalls and degraded completions — accounts: ACCT-1182, ACCT-4417. CS is standing by to notify if it looks like sustained degradation.
Evan: seeing p95 ~800ms but p99 jumps to 2.7-3.1s for streaming sessions. Non-streaming requests are mostly fine.
Jamal: on the router logs there's a tight cluster of connection handoffs to a small set of backends in zone us-west2-b. Looks like a routing policy churn.
Priya (oncall): can you paste the offending policy eval?
Jamal: 
```
# snippet from router-policy-eval
route match: streaming=true -> gateway:lb-v2
policy: prefer_local -> weights { us-west2-a:0.2, us-west2-b:0.7, /* fallback */ eu-central:0.1 }
note: hotkey smoothing disabled for route lb-v2
```
Morgan: aha — smoothing disabled means hot partitions aren't being spread, and we have a micro-hotkey from a customer replay. That explains hot backend saturation and tail stalls.
Priya (oncall): assign temporary mitigations: 1) re-enable hotkey smoothing on lb-v2, 2) reduce weight for us-west2-b, 3) trigger KV cache priming where possible. Who can apply?
Evan: I can flip smoothing and adjust weights. Will push change via control plane.
Jamal: I'll start draining the top overloaded nodes after weight shift.
Priya (oncall): ETA?
Evan: making the config change now. Command: 
```
rbctl policy set lb-v2 --enable-hotkey-smoothing=true
rbctl route adjust-weight --route lb-v2 --zone us-west2-b --weight 0.25
rbctl route adjust-weight --route lb-v2 --zone us-west2-a --weight 0.55
rbctl route adjust-weight --route lb-v2 --zone eu-central --weight 0.2
```
Evan: applied. Watching metrics. :eyes:
incident-bot: config-change detected by deploy-bot (evan) at 5100004380 — policy update rolled.
Morgan: initial signs look good. p99 dropped from ~3s to ~1.4s in the affected stream pool. Throughput is stable.
Lena (cs): Customer reports that streaming resumed for ACCT-1182, but ACCT-4417 still sees one stalled session. I'm coordinating with them.
Priya (oncall): Jamal, start the drain on the top 3 outlier nodes in us-west2-b and mark them for investigation. Use rolling drain to avoid extra tail.
Jamal: started drain via 
```
rbctl node drain node-uw2b-17 --grace 60
rbctl node drain node-uw2b-19 --grace 60
rbctl node drain node-uw2b-21 --grace 60
```
Jamal: draining; CPU and queue depth on those nodes are falling. We'll grab heap/proc and tcp snapshots for postmortem.
Evan: also noticed an oddness in routing-telemetry — weight controller was re-evaluating every 3s due to an aggressive health check TTL. That amplified oscillation when a backend had momentary GC spikes.
Morgan: root cause hypothesis: a combination of (1) policy change that disabled hotkey smoothing, (2) aggressive health/weight tuning causing rapid weight shifts, (3) customer replay causing a hot partition. The combination led to persistent hot backend saturation and tail latency spikes.
Priya (oncall): Good summary. Current status?
Evan: p95 steady ~350ms, p99 ~1.2s, streaming stalls nearly resolved. Drains progressing, no rollback needed.
Lena (cs): Sending interim note to impacted customers. We'll follow up if stalls reappear.
Priya (oncall): Open a sev-doc and assign postmortem owners: Evan for policy/controls, Jamal for node-level diagnostics, Morgan for mitigation automation, Lena for customer comms.
Evan: creating sev-doc now — link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/sev/5100004321 (will update with logs/traces)
Jamal: captured tcpdump and jstack from the three nodes and uploaded to the sev doc.
Morgan: I'll schedule an emergency runbook change to avoid disabling hotkey smoothing without a canary and to add a cooldown to weight recalculation.
Priya (oncall): Actions before handoff: 1) keep an eye on p99 for 30m, 2) confirm no new customer complaints, 3) collect any remaining traces. If stable, we'll downgrade paging to watch.
Evan: monitoring dashboard pinned to #incidents — graph: router.us-west2.lb-v2.p99 and streaming.stall-rate.
Lena (cs): ACCT-4417 confirmed recovery after the drain finished. No further customer-impact alerts.
Priya (oncall): Good. I'm signing off primary oncall in 12 minutes; handoff to Morgan (secondary) for watch. Morgan, you accept?
Morgan: accepting. Will watch for 30m and then close the thread if stable.
Priya (oncall): Thanks team. Postmortem owners, please coordinate and keep it blameless. Add follow-ups: stricter policy gate, cooldown on weight controller, automated hotkey smoothing detection.
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> watch. Escalation cleared at 5100004567.
Morgan: closing notes: learned that small config toggles + aggressive control loops can cascade — adding guardrails to the policy API and telemetry alarms. Will follow up with PRs and runbook edits. :thumbsup:
